notToBeConfusedWith.name: Ginger ale
notToBeConfusedWith.note: A paler, drier, less gingery mixer historically brewed rather than syrup-based; not interchangeable in a drink that names ginger beer specifically.

forms.label: Standard
forms.sourceNote: USDA carries no generic ginger beer, and bottled ginger beers vary widely by brand - some run past 9 g sugar per 100 ml. Figures are Schweppes Ginger Beer (Open Food Facts, ODbL) as a representative, widely-sold bottling. Its ingredient list (carbonated water, sugar, acidity correctors, acacia gum, natural flavouring) is entirely plant-derived, so animalOrigin is none. Density has no liquid measurement on file and is taken from the water-like class in density-classes.json, marked estimated. acidPercent left off: no titratable acidity source exists.
